summary: Full-stack testing of the professional User & Roles Management System. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_rbac_v2.py covering: GET /admin/users filters (role/status/sort=name|last_login|recent) + fields (role, status, permissions, is_admin, created_at); PUT /admin/users/{uid}/status suspend + login blocked (403 'Account sospeso') + reactivate restores login + sessions revoked; non-admin 403 on suspend endpoint; PUT /admin/users/{uid}/role rejects 'administrator' (400) but accepts collaborator/listener (perms filtered against PERM_SECTIONS) + activity logged; POST /admin/invitations (admin-only, 403 for non-admin) returns 201 with accept_url + email_sent=false (EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY empty in dev — expected); GET /admin/invitations lists pending; DELETE /admin/invitations/{id} revokes; GET /invitations/{token} (public) exposes email/role/permissions; POST /invitations/{token}/accept creates account with invited role+permissions and returns session token; token cannot be reused (second accept -> 404); GET /admin/activity returns audit entries with actor_name+action+created_at (admin-only, 403 for others); RBAC 'team' collaborator can GET /admin/crew (200) but not /admin/users or /admin/activity (403); public regression /live/status, /podcasts, /news, /products all 200; /auth/me still returns role+permissions. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): /welcome shows exactly 3 cards (Accedi, Registrati, Continua come Ospite) and NO 'Amministrazione' text anywhere; admin email/password login redirects to /admin; /admin/users renders search box, role filter chips (Tutti/Admin/Collaboratori/Ascoltatori), status filter chips, sort chips, 21 user cards with avatar+name+email+role badge+status badge+last_login+created date+kebab menu; Invite modal opens, sends invite, shows 'Invito creato. L\'email non è ancora attiva: copia il link dall\'elenco qui sotto' banner + revocable pending invites list with copy/trash icons; /admin/activity groups entries by day with actor+action+time; /invite?token=INVALID shows 'Invito non valido' error page with 'Vai alla Home' CTA; /invite?token=VALID renders acceptance form with email, role label, permission chips, name+password inputs; submitting form creates the collaborator account and lands on /admin/podcasts (first permitted section).

action_items: (carry-over) Migrate shadow* StyleSheet props to boxShadow and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to silence RN 0.76+ warnings.
(carry-over) Consider splitting server.py (1600+ lines) into APIRouter modules (auth/admin/users/invitations/content/merch).
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /admin/users/{uid}/status correctly revokes sessions on suspend (db.user_sessions.delete_many) — verified: old bearer token returns 401 after suspend.
POST /admin/invitations replaces any previous pending invite for the same email (delete_many status=pending) — prevents multiple tokens per invitee. Good.
GET /invitations/{token} + accept both reject non-pending or expired tokens correctly.

accept_invitation() reads invited role+permissions from the invitation, applies ROLE_ADMIN override if email in ADMIN_EMAILS, hashes password, marks invite accepted (single-use), returns session token — clean.

PERM_SECTIONS = [podcasts, news, merch, schedule, prayers, messages, team, radio]; require_perm('team') is used on all /admin/crew endpoints (verified test collab-with-team gets 200 on GET /admin/crew).
log_activity() correctly writes actor_name/action/target/meta/created_at. Sorted DESC in GET /admin/activity.
server.py is now 1601 lines — splitting is overdue but non-blocking.
send_email() gracefully returns False when EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY is empty (dev). No exceptions raised.
